title: Call for Book Chapters – Second Edition
text:
The Department of Computer Science, PDUAM Amjonga invites original and unpublished research chapters for the 2nd Edition of the international edited volume 'Advances in Multidisciplinary Research and Innovation' published by Deep Science Publishing.

📅 Last Date of Submission: 31 July 2026
📖 Expected Publication: 30 August 2026
💰 Publication Fee: ₹400 per accepted chapter

Themes include Arts & Humanities, Science & Innovation, Commerce & Management, AI & Emerging Technologies, Teaching & Education, and Social Sciences.

📧 Submit Chapters: cscpduambookchapter@gmail.com
📞 Contact: +91 9401800625

🔗 DOI: https://doi.org/10.70593/978-93-7185-110-7
meta: Submission Deadline: 31 July 2026 | Submission Email: cscpduambookchapter@gmail.com
